purpose: Exclude confirmed non-Busan construction/service site contracts from Busan procurement monitoring rate denominators and numerators.
policy: Confirmed non-Busan site contracts by non-Busan local-government agencies are excluded from award-rate calculation. Busan local-government offsite contracts remain included.
note: Rows originally estimated/needs_confirmation were promoted after user confirmed public notices show non-Busan sites on 2026-06-15.
